questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2023] Consider the following statements : Statement-I The soil in tropical rain forests is rich in nutrients. Statement-II The high temperature and moisture of tropical rain forests cause dead organic matter in the soil to decompose quickly. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
optionsEn: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect.
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.
optionsHi: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I

Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.. Tropical rainforests have extremely poor soil, in contrast to the common misconception that because of the abundance of plants, warmth and moisture, the soil must be quite rich. Hence statement-I is false. Notably, tropical rainforests have higher temperatures and more moisture than the other regions, which accelerates the decomposition of dead organic matter in the soil and releases nutrients more rapidly. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2023]
